record.remaining_window_review: Actual raw all_stage, realshow and processed inventories end at D37; no local D38 candidates/labels/exposures were found. The last causal D36 training was completed with all159106 requests and full optimizer ancestry, and complete-day D37 fixed4096 pilot plus disjoint8192 diagnostic both completed with independent reviews. Their directions disagree, so this candidate remains unpublished. The accepted chain ends V7 (trainD35/evalD36); no new strictly future day remains for another daily release/evaluation. A two-day publication was already actually trained and evaluated. Additional configurations or more unused users on the same terminal date are conceivable, but were not scheduled and are not needed by the explicitly authorized temporal-boundary stopping alternative. This record means temporal-data exhaustion for forward progression, not exhaustive hyperparameter search or every user scored on every day.
record.scientific_conclusion: An adaptively developed real-ancestry eight-model chain with seven positive primary point estimates. Four stronger development cases, one weaker cohort-consistency case, two smaller effects supported by adaptive full-population supplements; not a uniformly stable ten-model demonstration. All adverse exploration preserved.
record.termination_conclusion: The revised user-authorized stop-and-deliver alternative is fulfilled; the preferred scientific/count targets are explicitly not claimed as achieved.

proof_scope: Actual models, ancestry, adjacent edges, increasing future windows, audited population/metrics and positive NDCG point estimates only; positive-edge counts do not establish stability.
stability_review_note: A separate actual per-edge review must assess uncertainty, cohort/time consistency and any supplemental evidence, retaining weak/adverse results. This checker imposes no new significance or slice threshold and does not infer stability from two positive points or a declared review path.
